task: Implement the M5 and remaining M6 UX safeguards for done_prepare: pre-DONE merge hazard guidance, repeated-run delta explanation, and dryRun/generated-file ownership proof.
outcome: When a developer runs done_prepare, the terminal shows exact merge hazard paths, compact rerun reasons, generated-file ownership guidance, and a focused smoke proves dryRun is inspect-only.
facts: This story is Story C from done-prepare-heartbeat-review-assurance-ux-execution-plan.md and covers M5 plus the remaining M6 safeguards.
The target implementation surface is packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts with a focused smoke at packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke.ts.
Existing done_prepare automation must not weaken DONE, review, delivery, scope, Authority, or verification gates.
Repeated done_prepare calls can be valid when prior runs generated metadata, merged main, changed material, or refreshed evidence.
done_prepare --dryRun must not change git state, evidence files, lifecycle metadata, process events, review artifacts, or gate-participating timestamps.
constraints: Do not auto-resolve merge conflicts, stash user work, delete files, or commit unrelated dirty files.
Do not auto-sign reviewer evidence, host verdicts, degraded fallback evidence, or delivery/review assurance records.
Keep JSON stdout parseable when adding human guidance or progress output.
Use CLI writers for story metadata; do not manually edit lifecycle JSON.
Keep the fix scoped to done_prepare UX and its focused regression smoke.
